images.name: hub_lvl0
images.description: The ruins of a small warehouse on the parking lot: a cracked concrete foundation slab with rubble, broken low walls and debris.

images.name: hub_lvl1
images.description: A small one-storey logistics warehouse with one truck loading dock and a roller door, flat dark roof with skylights.

images.name: hub_lvl2
images.description: A mid-sized logistics warehouse with two loading docks with roller doors and yellow safety bollards, a small office annex, skylights on the flat roof.

images.name: hub_lvl3
images.description: A large logistics warehouse with four loading docks in a row, roller doors, a two-storey office annex with windows, roof skylights and ventilation units.

images.name: hub_lvl4
images.description: A very large logistics warehouse with six loading docks in a row, light grey metal cladding with a wide blue stripe, a glass office block at one corner and solar panels on the flat roof.

images.name: hub_lvl5
images.description: A huge high-tech logistics hub with eight loading docks, sleek metal and glass facade, a glass office tower at one corner, rooftop solar panel arrays and antennas.

images.name: fueltank_lvl0
images.description: Isometric three-quarter view from above. Ruins of a small fuel station: a cracked concrete slab, scattered grey rubble and a rusty fallen fuel tank.

images.name: fueltank_lvl1
images.description: Seen from above at a three-quarter isometric angle, small and low. A tiny makeshift fuel point: a few old rusty oil barrels with a hand pump on a small concrete slab, a red jerrycan next to them.

images.name: fueltank_lvl2
images.description: A small fuel point: one white plastic cube fuel tank in a metal cage on a concrete slab, with a simple hose and nozzle.

images.name: fueltank_lvl3
images.description: A small fuel station: one horizontal cylindrical steel fuel tank on steel legs on a concrete slab, a single fuel pump next to it.

images.name: fueltank_lvl4
images.description: A fuel station with an underground tank: a concrete slab with round manhole covers and vent pipes, one modern fuel pump under a small metal canopy.

images.name: fueltank_lvl5
images.description: A private fuel station: two fuel pumps on a raised island under a flat blue-trimmed canopy, a horizontal steel fuel tank behind them.

images.name: fueltank_lvl6
images.description: A professional fuel station: four fuel pumps under a large flat canopy with a blue stripe, two large horizontal steel fuel tanks behind.

images.name: fueltank_lvl7
images.description: An industrial fuel depot: one big vertical cylindrical steel storage tank with a staircase around it, a concrete containment wall, a small pump station in front.

images.name: fueltank_lvl8
images.description: A regional fuel depot: two big vertical cylindrical steel storage tanks with staircases and walkways, a concrete containment wall and a pump canopy.

images.name: fueltank_lvl9
images.description: Seen from above at a three-quarter isometric angle, the tank roofs clearly visible, compact so the whole site fits. A fuel terminal: three large vertical cylindrical steel storage tanks linked by walkways and pipe racks, a concrete containment wall and a loading gantry.

images.name: fueltank_lvl10
images.description: A huge private fuel hub: four very large white vertical storage tanks with blue stripes, pipe racks and walkways, a loading gantry and a small control tower.

images.name: office_lvl0
images.description: The ruins of a small office building on the parking lot: a cracked concrete slab with rubble, broken low brick walls and broken window frames.

images.name: office_lvl1
images.description: A small single-storey office building for a trucking company: flat roof, a row of windows, a blue front door with a small awning, an air conditioning unit on the roof.
